PreceptDef.label: funeral of the Dao
PreceptDef.description: When a disciple dies the sect does not weep: it burns paper money and calls the name three times so that the qi they gathered can return to the Dao. The grave is dug facing the mountain.
PreceptDef.extraTextPawnDeathLetter: {PAWN_nameDef} should be buried and given a funeral of the Dao, so the qi {PAWN_pronoun} gathered can return to the heavens.
